name: _selection_rule
declared: 2026-11-25 before any run. Development seeds 1001-1010, FLASK-RRTConnect, both unicycle cases. Eligible: 20/20 attempts valid on the ORIGINAL unicycle model (exact |v|<=1, |omega|<=1.5 along every edge, original boxes, DynoBench goal with heading). Choose the eligible candidate with the smallest sum over the two cases of the median number of edge checks; ties by median iterations. If no candidate is eligible: the most valid attempts, then the same work rule. Times and lengths are recorded but never used for selection. Evidence priority for any further candidate: paper > author code > library defaults.
